parameters.name: AuthorizedSecurityGroups
parameters.description: A list of authorized security group IDs.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain the instance ID.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. The default value is **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English
